newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Bank sees Russian Chelyabinsk telecom a buy in 97.
newsitem.headline: Bank sees Russian Chelyabinsk telecom a buy in 97.

text.p: Moscow investment bank Renaissance Capital on Thursday named Russian regional telecoms firm Chelyabinsk Svyazinform a "first-class second-tier" 1997 stock.

Renaissance said in a market report AO Chelybinsk Svyazinform has grown in the past three years and will continue to do so, with the dollar-equivalent earnings forecast to rise 29 percent in 1997 and 13 percent in 1998.

"It is Chelyabinsk Svyazinform's healthy growth prospects and low price to earnings relative to the sector that prompt our purchase recommendation for both the common and preferred stock," said telecoms analyst Yuri Krapivin in the report.
Chelyabinsk Svyazinform expanded at a 12 percent compound annual growth rate between 1993 and 1996.
It is planning to digitalise its local network, develop a regional fibre-optic loop and add 150,000 lines to its existing 540,000 by the year 2000, Krapivin said.
"We therefore recommend the purchase of both the company's ordinary and preferred shares, as the stock offers investors good value," he said.
Analysts have predicted Russia's telecoms sector will be one of the leading sectors in 1997.
